name: Stuffed Peppers (Vegetarian)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Cut onion into small cubes and fry in olive oil until brown.
Add water, tomato juice, parsley, soup cube, cheese, garlic, black olives and rice. Season to taste.
Fill into the peppers. Cook for 30 minutes. Rest as above.

culture.text: Stuffed peppers is a dish common in many cuisines. It consists of hollowed or halved bell peppers filled with any of a variety of fillings, often including meat, vegetables, cheese, rice, or sauce. The dish is usually assembled by filling the cavities of the peppers and then cooking.
